title: G-ring criterion by formal fibres of the quotients R/q
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Then $R$ is a G-ring [def-weil-pbc-g-ring] if and only if the following holds for every pair of prime ideals $\mathfrak q\subseteq\mathfrak p$ of $R$: put $B=R/\mathfrak q$ (a domain) and $\bar{\mathfrak p}=\mathfrak p/\mathfrak q$, let $B_{\bar{\mathfrak p}}$ be the localization of $B$ at $\bar{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] and $(B_{\bar{\mathfrak p}})^\wedge=\varprojlim_nB_{\bar{\mathfrak p}}/\bar{\mathfrak p}^nB_{\bar{\mathfrak p}}$ its completion at its maximal ideal [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], and let $\kappa(\mathfrak q)=R_{\mathfrak q}/\mathfrak qR_{\mathfrak q}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], which is the fraction field $B_{(0)}$ of $B$; then the $\kappa(\mathfrak q)$-algebra $(B_{\bar{\mathfrak p}})^\wedge\otimes_B\kappa(\mathfrak q)$ is Noetherian and geometrically regular over $\kappa(\mathfrak q)$ [def-weil-pbc-g-ring]. (The algebra is the formal fibre $(R_{\mathfrak p})^\wedge\otimes_R\kappa(\mathfrak q)$ of $R_{\mathfrak p}$ over $\mathfrak q$.)

split_report.summary: Checked against Stacks 07PN (more-algebra.tex line 12194) and the remark around 07GH (lines 12160-12191); tags 07PN, 07GH, 07BZ, 00MA verified in tags/tags. def-weil-pbc-g-ring requires R_p -> R_p^ regular for every prime p (Stacks 07GH), so no passage between maximal ideals and primes is needed. Proof written in 7 steps: Noetherianity of R_p, R_p^ and of all fibre rings; the identity (R/q)_p^ (x)_{R/q} kappa(q) = R_p^ (x)_R kappa(q) as kappa(q)-algebras (Stacks' proof of 07PN), via R_p -> (R/q)_{p} surjective with kernel qR_p (localization-at-prime-of-quotient), completion of a quotient of a Noetherian local ring (local-completion-quotient), A^/IA^ = A^ (x) A/I (tensor-quotient-base-change) and cancellation of base change; vanishing of the fibres of R -> R_p^ over primes not contained in p; R_p -> R_p^ regular iff R -> R_p^ regular (localization-regular + regular-composition, regular-through-localization), which makes Stacks' 'fibres over the primes qR_p' precise without a separate prime-correspondence node; R -> R_p^ is flat, so it is regular iff the fibres over q in p are Noetherian and geometrically regular. Every step uses existing nodes of unit sk-thm-p1 or definitions; no new node was needed. Statement and stmt_deps kept. The Noetherian clause of the condition is carried through the equivalence (it also holds automatically by Step 1).

reviewed.note: 7 steps: fibres Noetherian; (R/q)_p^ = R_p^/qR_p^ via localization-of-quotient and local-completion-quotient; Stacks' identity via tensor-quotient-base-change and cancel base change; fibres over q not in p vanish; R_p -> R_p^ regular iff R -> R_p^ regular (localization-regular, regular-composition, regular-through-localization); flatness; conclusion. No new nodes. Tags 07PN, 07GH verified. def-weil-pbc-g-ring quantifies over all primes, as Stacks 07GH.

lean.statement: theorem isGRing_iff_pairsOfPrimes (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] : IsGRing R ↔ ∀ (q p : Ideal R) [q.IsPrime] [p.IsPrime] (hqp : q ≤ p), let pbar := p.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk q) letI : pbar.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_map_quotientMk_of_isPrime hqp let L := Localization.AtPrime pbar let C := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal L) L let F := TensorProduct (R ⧸ q) q.ResidueField C IsNoetherianRing F ∧ Algebra.IsGeometricallyRegular q.ResidueField F
